summary: Freeze and test successor gate V3. Remove composed-vs-isolated projection equality. Accept composition only when mixed-task gain clears a frozen threshold, each source adapter still passes its own isolated evaluation, and mixed-task semantic assertions pass. Evaluate orthogonal additive safe, overlapping additive safe, and A-overrides-C conflict across fixed seeds.
pass_condition: accept both safe classes and reject conflict for every fixed seed without threshold edits
kill_condition: any class misclassification after frozen thresholds, or success requires privileged answer-key-like routing labels
